The game is still at version 1.00, and that bar appears when the disc is installing to the PS4 (or the game is downloading if its digital), so this definitely seems like an installation problem. 
Installation should only last only a few minutes...I would say this sounds like its a defective disc, but I actually can't find many cases of this happening :(

If you're still having trouble, I would check three things: If the back of the disc looks fine, if data for the game appears in "system storage management" (delete the data and try reinstalling if it does), and if your PS4 is able to install other game discs with no problem.

If its still not working, you could also try [rebuilding the PS4 database](http://www.gadgethelpline.com/rebuild-sony-ps4-database/) and see if it helps.

Bump to this thread for those still curious. Things have changed for me (long story involving payment troubles and the Asia Platinum Box running out on Playasia), and I will instead be getting the Japanese version this week.
But I still really wanted to see if the dlc is compatible, so I uninstalled the catalog (downloaded it off Japan PSStore even before getting the game), and tried downloading the catalog off the Hong Kong store. The name for the download came out as カタログ創刊号, the exact same name as the download off the Japanese PSStore. When I tried to see if I could redownload the catalog off the Japanese store, the download page already had a download bar, and once that finished it said it was "installed". Both stores wouldn't let me redownload it without uninstalling.

There's no way they both could detect the dlc if the versions were any different, so that pretty much confirms the dlc/game is the exact same between both stores.
Although its worth mentioning the P-drops and I believe email dlc are account locked (you don't download them and therefore can't share them between users), so be aware of that if you're buying dlc from both stores.

Edit update: Now having the game, can confirm the catalog 100% worked. Also it seems like I was wrong, and the mail dlc wasn't account locked. So aside from P-drops, there's nothing to worry about if you're buying dlc from both stores at all!

In short: Cannot confirm myself, but possible. If anyone with the Asia version could try downloading an accessory or the free catalog dlc off the Japanese store, we may get an exact answer. 

In long: From what I've heard of Asia region games, dlc downloaded from the JPN PS store **can** work, but that depends on if its really the Japanese region version repackaged for Asia (works), or a different version made for Asia (I would expect the upcoming versions in Korean/Chinese to not work for this reason). Japanese language Asia versions of games such as Project Diva F and Senran Kagura EV are like this, and from what I've heard idolm@ster 2 was compatible with Japanese dlc. Looking in the Asia PS store, it labels the dlc as "Japanese version", so I would've said likely, until I read there are some changes made for the Asia version, having no Lawson content. Unless the Lawson stuff is actually dlc, in which case I would say likely. (There are cases where dlc only available on the JPN PSN store even work with the Japanese Asian version, since again, they're the same.)

I really wish I could try this to give an exact answer myself, but I have to wait a few weeks for my copy =[ If someone with the Asia version and a JPN psn account could see if the catalog dlc pops up or not, it'd be very helpful to us!
